i.norm: Verifies that Nysiis encodes a mixed alphanumeric/special-character string by stripping non-letter characters, applying phonetic transcoding rules, and truncating to the 6-character strict-mode limit. Input "tl1[CoH5>Aeu)UA;J." contains digits, brackets, angle-brackets, and a period that are removed during cleaning. The remaining letters "tlCoHAeuUAJ" are then phonetically encoded to "TLCAHA".
Default constructor uses strict mode (max 6 characters in the output)
